AirForce Delta.name: Airforce Delta
AirForce Delta.summary:
As a jet fighter pilot in a civil war, the player will take to the skies in a behind-the-plane view for ten missions with a selection of up to eight aircraft.

To complete a mission, the player must destroy a certain number of enemy aircraft or ground targets then destroy a boss air or ground craft. Each mission will reward the player with money. When the player has beaten the boss, the money may then be used to purchase new planes and upgrades for those planes.

F-1 World Grand Prix.name: F-1 World Grand Prix
F-1 World Grand Prix.summary: F-1 World Grand Prix is a Formula 1 racing game for the Game Boy Color, based on the Nintendo 64 title. The Game Boy Color iteration features an official license of the 1998 season and thus all 11 authentic teams, drivers and tracks from that year. Unlike the Nintendo 64 version the game is completely in 2D and is viewed from a 3rd person perspective.

Puyo Puyo Gaiden - Puyo Wars.name: Puyo Puyo Gaiden: Puyo Wars
Puyo Puyo Gaiden - Puyo Wars.summary: A strategy RPG very loosely based on Puyo Puyo.
